This article is about the 24w14potato grid of blocks.   For the current grid of blocks, see Debug mode/Grid.   For the upcoming grid, see Debug mode/Grid/upcoming.



This article is a work in progress. 
Please help expand and improve it. The talk page may contain suggestions.Note: Section change blocks states





This article documents an April Fools' Day joke. 
This feature was exclusively part of a joke version and is not currently planned for addition to regular Minecraft.



This article would benefit from the addition of more images. 
Please remove this notice once you have added  suitable images to the article.The specific instructions are: Potted Potato flower sprite

This page lists all the rows in the debug mode block grid in 24w14potato.
There are 172 lines with up to 173 block states. The last line has 19 block states. Therefore, there are 29,602 block states in total.
The first block is located at coordinates (1, 70, 1) and each block is 2 blocks away from its adjacent blocks, thus the block in row r, column c is at coordinates (2r-1, 70, 2c-1).
